quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must stop completely and wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed shown.
The maximum speed you can drive is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed you can drive is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed allowed on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
You can only turn from certain lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. These lanes are for buses and cars with the driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What should you adjust first when you get in a car to drive?
questions.explanation: First, adjust your seat so you are comfortable and can see the road. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel based on your new seat position.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Always drive at the maximum speed limit.
Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction.
questions.explanation: Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction on slippery roads. Slow down and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Start signaling as you move into the next lane.
Signal 500 feet ahead on residential streets.

questions.explanation: Other cars and motorcycles can hide in your blind spot, so look over your shoulder before changing lanes. Signal 100 feet ahead on residential streets and 5 seconds ahead on freeways.

questions.question: You are driving on a highway with two solid yellow lines. You may:

options.text: Cross them only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
Cross them to pass other vehicles if no traffic is coming.
Cross them only to make a U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross them only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing is allowed in either direction. You may only cross them to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: It is legal to drive faster than the speed limit when passing another vehicle.
questions.explanation: You cannot drive faster than the speed limit at any time, even when passing another vehicle.

questions.question: The $500 uninsured motor vehicle fee provides basic liability insurance.
questions.explanation: The $500 uninsured motorist fee does not provide insurance. It only allows you to register and drive the vehicle in Virginia for one year.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: The blind spot of a large vehicle

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot of a large vehicle
questions.explanation: A "No zone" is the large blind spot around trucks and big vehicles. Avoid staying in these areas.

questions.question: Car drivers should know that large trucks:

options.text: Can stop faster than regular cars.
Do not need more space to turn than regular cars.

questions.explanation: Large trucks have big blind spots in front, on the sides, and in back. Stay out of these areas. Trucks need more space to turn and stop than regular cars because they are bigger and heavier.

questions.question: On a road with no sidewalks, a pedestrian should walk on the:

options.text: Same side where traffic is moving.

questions.explanation: Walk on the side of the road where you face the traffic coming toward you.

questions.question: When you make an emergency stop on the road, you do not need to use your parking brake.
questions.explanation: Always set your parking brake during an emergency stop. Turn on your emergency lights to warn other drivers.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs warn you to slow down at an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: Pennant-shaped signs mean:
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones. The sign will have words on it to confirm you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: Warning signs are most commonly:
questions.explanation: Most warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black text. They warn drivers about unexpected road conditions ahead.

questions.question: In business districts, cities, and towns, U-turns are allowed only:
questions.explanation: U-turns are only allowed at intersections in business districts, cities, and towns.

questions.question: To turn left from a multilane, one-way street or highway, start from:
questions.explanation: Always start a left turn from the left lane on multilane streets and highways.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Get ready for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Follow the detour route to avoid dangerous conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour route to avoid dangerous conditions.
questions.explanation: These signs tell you the traffic route has changed because of road work ahead. Follow the detour signs.

questions.question: You are backing out of your driveway and see children playing nearby. Before you move your car, you should:

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children you are moving.
Honk your horn so the children hear you.
Get out and walk to the back of the car to check it is clear.
Tell the children to stay away from the driveway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out and walk to the back of the car to check it is clear.
questions.explanation: Before backing up, get out of your car and check behind it. Do not rely only on your mirrors, especially with children nearby. Always look directly behind your vehicle before backing into or out of a driveway.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: It is okay to follow motorcycles closely.
A motorcycle with two riders is more balanced than one with one rider.
You must move completely into the left lane to pass a motorcycle.
Motorcycles always use their brake lights when slowing down.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must move completely into the left lane to pass a motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles need a full lane of space. Move your entire vehicle into the left lane before passing a motorcycle on the left.

questions.question: Why is it important to watch for motorcycles?

options.text: They are harder to see than cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are harder to see than cars.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are small and easy to miss. They can hide in your blind spot. It is hard to judge how far away they are or how fast they are going. Always watch for motorcycles carefully.

questions.question: Is it legal to transport children under 16 in a pickup truck bed if it has a camper shell?
questions.explanation: It is illegal to transport children under 16 in a pickup truck bed, even with a camper shell.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the bridge ahead.
The bridge has one-way traffic only.
Only one car at a time can use the bridge.
The bridge may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck. Drive carefully and be ready.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What do pentagonal signs mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs show you are in a school zone. Watch carefully for children and pedestrians.

questions.question: If a solid white line on the right edge of the road angles toward the center, it means:

options.text: You are approaching a construction area.
You will have to turn left soon.

questions.explanation: A solid edge line marks the road boundary. If it angles toward the center, the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: When crossing a railroad track with no signals or gates, you should:

options.text: Have the right-of-way and not check for trains.
Make sure your vehicle has room to cross completely without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your vehicle has room to cross completely without stopping.
questions.explanation: Before entering railroad tracks, check that you have enough space to get all the way across. Never pass another vehicle at a railroad crossing. Always look for trains before crossing any tracks.

questions.question: When parking next to a curb, how far away can you park?
questions.explanation: You cannot park more than one foot away from the curb on a public road.

questions.question: Your car's accelerator gets stuck while driving on a busy street. What should you do?

options.text: Turn off the ignition carefully without locking the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off the ignition carefully without locking the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: If the accelerator sticks, the engine will keep running even if you lift your foot off the gas. Turn off the ignition gently—move it just enough to stop the engine without locking the steering wheel. Then apply the brakes and move to a safe area.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane will end. All traffic in that lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What happens to your field of vision when you drive faster?
questions.explanation: As you drive faster, your field of vision becomes narrower. When driving at high speeds, you must stay extra alert for hazards.

questions.question: Stopping distance does NOT depend on:

options.text: The condition and type of your tires.

questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on your reaction time, weather, visibility, vehicle weight, brake condition, tire condition and type, road conditions, and speed. The time of day itself does not affect stopping distance.
